item.text: {"summary":"The target contract and forecast fields are coherent, but the material point-estimate update is not supported by cited, quantitative current evidence and the draft does not clearly address a time-series/model prior.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"model_prior","severity":"warning","summary":"The draft uses a same-month persistence sample but neither applies a time-series model nor explicitly explains why one is unsuitable for this seasonal monthly cash-flow target.","actionRequested":"Add a concise statement ruling out a time-series model (for example, because the five-observation same-month sample is too small and payment timing dominates), or provide a clearly specified model prior and its result."},{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"blocking","summary":"The +20.0 billion outlay adjustment and -8.1 billion customs-receipt offset are asserted without dated, quantitative evidence or a source showing why they apply to July 2026.","actionRequested":"Cite official current evidence for both adjustment components, state the relevant amounts/changes and translation to the July monthly balance, or remove/scale back unsupported adjustments and revise the point estimate accordingly."}],"optionalSuggestions":["State whether the reported 41.0 billion sigma is the sample standard deviation to make the interval method fully reproducible.","Cite the Treasury historical-note source for the 68-of-70 July-deficit claim, or omit that statistic."]}
